days.title: Alpnachstad and the Summit Experience
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Alpnachstad
stops.detail: The world’s steepest cogwheel railway starts its climb at Alpnachstad and tackles a maximum gradient of 48 percent, thereby passing forests, meadows and rock faces.

stops.name: Eselwand
stops.detail: The world’s steepest cog railway from Alpnachstad to Pilatus (48% gradient), spectacular passage “Eselwand”

stops.name: Pilatus Kulm
stops.detail: On the north side, a gondola cableway and an aerial cableway connect Kriens to Pilatus Kulm.

stops.name: Hotel Pilatus-Kulm
stops.detail: Evening summit rendezvous in summer (from Alpnachstad), Restaurant Krienseregg and Restaurant Chalet, Hotel Pilatus-Kulm

days.driving: Allow time between these sights; local travel times are not verified and conditions vary.

days.title: North Slope and Intermediate Heights
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Krienseregg
stops.detail: Gondola from Kriens (Lucerne) via Krienseregg to Fräkmuntegg, aerial cableway to Pilatus Kulm or cog railway (only during summer) from Alpnachstad (boat or train from Lucerne) to Pilatus Kulm

stops.name: Fräkmüntegg
stops.detail: It takes the cableway a mere 3.5 minutes to reach Pilatus (2,132 m a.s.l.) from the intermediate station Fräkmüntegg (1,416 m a.s.l.).

stops.name: Oberhaupt
stops.detail: Cliff walk and secured trails to the viewpoint Oberhaupt
